data.investment_objective:
BHARAT Bond ETF FOF - April 2033 is a fund of funds scheme with the primary objective to generate returns by investing in units of BHARAT Bond ETF – April 2033.
However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized.
data.asset_allocation:
1. Units of BHARAT Bond ETF – April 2033 - 95-100%
2. Government Securities maturing on or before maturity date of the Scheme, TREPS and REPO in government bonds - 0-5%
data.exit_load:
• If redeemed or switched out on or before 
completion of 30 days from the date of allotment 
of units –0.10%
• If redeemed or switched out after completion of 
30 days from the date of allotment of units –NIL
